title: MasteryCalculationPolicy
description: WO-014.2 Mastery Calculation Policy — documents how observed Learning State metrics may eventually map to mastery_status. Policy only. Does not calculate real student mastery, assume weakness, or emit recommendations.

policy_status.description: Policy is authored and reviewable. Not applied to any student.

policy_execution.description: WO-014.2 forbids running mastery assignment against real or mock students.

unit_of_mastery.description: Mastery is evaluated per pattern_state.pattern_id, not per chapter or student global score.

preferred_pattern_scope.description: Learning Layer preferred patterns. Metadata documents concept/solving; does not invent mastery.

applies_to_learning_state_field.description: Future Apply WO may extend Student Learning State enum. WO-014 still locks enum to unknown only.

mastery_confidence_enum.description: Confidence in the mastery_status label itself. Distinct from error_states.confidence (WO-014 still unknown-only).

candidate_parameters.description: Numeric candidates for a future Apply WO. NOT executed in WO-014.2. Human/Architecture approval required before Learning State enum extension.

min_attempts_for_any_labeled_state.description: Below this → insufficient_data (when attempts exist) or unknown (when none).

recent_window_size.description: Last N pattern-scoped attempts used for recent_performance.

review_required_recent_accuracy_max.description: If recent_accuracy ≤ this after prior developing/mastered eligibility signals, review_required is eligible — still multi-gate, not accuracy-only.

student_learning_state_mastery_enum_wo01.description: data/student-learning-state-schema.json still allows mastery_status=unknown only until a future Apply WO.

recommendation_next_action.description: WO-014.2 does not define or expand recommendation_state.next_action.

error_taxonomy_driven_mastery.description: WO-013.3 verified error count is 0 — error-driven mastery/review gates stay blocked.

accuracy_alone_sufficient.description: Always false. Accuracy alone never decides mastery_status.

mastery_status_enum.meaning: Mastery not evaluated. Includes empty Learning State, pre-Apply lock (WO-014 enum), or explicit non-evaluation. Does not mean 'weak' or 'strong'.
At least one attempt may exist for the pattern, but attempt_count is below the minimum required to label learning/developing/mastered/review_required.
Minimum data met; early competence signal only. Student is practicing the pattern but has not met developing multi-gate conditions.
Sustained practice with improving or stable metrics across attempt_count, accuracy, and recent_performance — not yet mastered, not review_required.
Multi-gate eligibility satisfied: enough attempts + overall accuracy gate + recent_performance gate (+ optional future verified-error stability). Accuracy alone never grants mastered.
Observed regression or instability relative to prior competence signals (e.g. recent_performance decline while attempt history is non-trivial). Not a synonym for 'low accuracy on first try'.

mastery_confidence_enum.meaning: No mastery evaluation performed (policy not executed or no basis).
Label is provisional: at/near minimum attempts or recent window sparse/unstable.
increase_conditions: recent_window has enough attempts to compute recent_performance

mastery_confidence_enum.meaning: Label supported by full metric set with consistent recent_performance.
increase_conditions: attempt_count exceeds minimum by a clear margin (candidate parameter)
recent_performance agrees with overall accuracy direction
no unresolved OCR/classification drift on linked evidence questions for that pattern

mastery_confidence_enum.meaning: Label repeatedly stable across multiple recent windows; optional future verified error_states show no rising critical error_id.
increase_conditions: multiple recent_window evaluations agree on the same mastery_status
optional: verified Error Taxonomy links available and non-escalating (currently blocked — verified errors = 0)

input_metrics.description: Number of verified attempts for the pattern.
input_metrics.nullable_when: never null when row exists; absence of row means no metric

input_metrics.description: correct_count / attempt_count when attempt_count > 0; else null.

input_metrics.source: question_history filtered by pattern_id, ordered by timestamp, last N = recent_window_size
input_metrics.description: Derived view: recent_attempt_count, recent_correct_count, recent_accuracy. Requires Attempt Ingest history. Not inventable.

minimum_data_requirements.rule: No mastery_status other than unknown/insufficient_data without meeting minimum attempt_count. Empty Learning State → unknown only.
conditions: If no pattern_state row and learning_data_status=empty → mastery conceptually unknown (no row).
If pattern_state exists and attempt_count < candidate min_attempts_for_any_labeled_state → insufficient_data eligible (not auto-written).
If attempt_count >= minimum → learning/developing/mastered/review_required may become eligible only via multi-gate transition_framework.
pattern-metadata-db concept/solving fields are NOT mastery inputs.

candidate_parameters.notes: Numeric values are CANDIDATES inspired by coach/weakness-config.json magnitudes for continuity discussion only. They are NOT applied. Accuracy-only shortcuts remain forbidden even if numbers match.

transition_framework.principle: Multi-metric eligibility. Accuracy is necessary for some gates but never sufficient alone. No automatic calculation in WO-014.2.

requires_all_of: No evaluation requested OR Learning State empty OR Apply WO not enabled
forbidden_shortcuts: Pre-seed all verified patterns as unknown rows to simulate a graph
Use accuracy alone when attempt_count is 1
Assume weakness from a single wrong

requires_all_of: Does not yet meet developing multi-gate
recent_performance computable or explicitly marked sparse→keep confidence low
forbidden_shortcuts: Declare learning from Pattern Metadata text
Map low accuracy directly to review_required on first window
Ignore recent_performance when overall accuracy is high
Use Pattern Master grade S as mastery

requires_all_of: recent_performance indicates decline or instability (candidate: recent_accuracy <= review_required_recent_accuracy_max)
Prior history non-trivial (not first-window cold start alone)
forbidden_shortcuts: Equate any wrong answer with review_required
Promote Error Taxonomy partial/pending to student review_required
Generate personalized next_action from this status in WO-014.2

forbidden_rules: Do not declare mastery from accuracy only
Do not modify Question DB / Answer SoT / Pattern DB / Pattern Metadata / Error Taxonomy
Do not calculate or write real student mastery_status in this WO
Do not treat pattern-metadata concept text as a mastery signal

unresolved_issues.issue: Student Learning State schema still locks mastery_status to unknown — Apply/Enum-Extension WO required before policy can write labels.
candidate_parameters remain pending_human; weakness-config numbers are continuity references only.
Error Taxonomy verified=0 blocks error-driven confidence elevation and error-driven review gates.
Recommendation Engine must not consume mastery labels until Apply WO + Human gate; next_action stays unknown.
